result.title: Efficient Edge-aware Attention Network for Graph Generation
result.comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Graph Foundation Models and the Workshop on Structured Probabilistic Inference & Generative Modeling, ICML 2026, Seoul, South Korea
result.summary: Graph generative models commonly use graph-specific Transformer architectures to jointly update node and edge features. However, these architectures do not directly benefit from recent hardware-aware attention implementations, limiting their scalability. The adaptation is, however, non-trivial: edge and graph-level features must be injected into pairwise attention scores, graph masks must be respected, and dynamic edge updates remain a major source of quadratic memory usage. We propose an edge-aware attention layer for graph generation that incorporates structural information through head-wise score modulation, while updating edge representations with a lightweight residual mechanism that retains attention-score dependent edge updates. This layer can be effectively implemented using PyTorch's FlexAttention. We achieve similar generation quality to our baseline while reducing peak GPU memory by around 65% and substantially improving training and sampling throughput. These results suggest that the proposed architecture is a practical step toward scalable graph foundation models.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一种用于图生成的 edge-aware attention 层，通过逐头调制注意力分数注入结构与边级信息，并用轻量残差机制更新边表示，借助 FlexAttention 实现以降低显存占用、提升吞吐。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作聚焦图生成模型的计算与显存效率，未涉及视觉证据、latent 推理状态、停止决策或监督分配；注意力分数调制与内存优化属通用工程手段，难以形成针对 LVR 的具体借鉴线索。
